result.title: SaMA: Morpho Adaptation via Asymmetric Expansion of Kronecker Product
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 61 pages, 29 figures, 25 tables. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT); Large Language Models (LLMs); Large Foundation Models
result.summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has attracted significant attention in the parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) landscape. However, its design suffers from two fundamental limitations. First, its invariance manifold induces flat directions in the loss landscape, creating an optimization bottleneck for adaptive optimizers. Second, its effective rank scales only linearly with the parameter budget. In this paper, we propose Scalable Morpho Adaptation (SaMA), a PEFT method grounded in a principled generalization of the Kronecker product. By relaxing the shared-block constraint in the perfect-shuffle factorization, SaMA spans from low to full rank and achieves a practical rank that scales quadratically with the parameter budget, up to full-rank. Furthermore, we show that its invariance manifold collapses to a diagonal group, making it structurally more optimizer-friendly. Empirically, SaMA consistently outperforms strong PEFT baselines on commonsense and arithmetic reasoning benchmarks while being more parameter-efficient.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SaMA，一种基于 Kronecker 积推广的 PEFT 方法，通过放宽 perfect-shuffle 分解中的共享块约束，使有效秩随参数预算二次增长，从而在常识与算术推理基准上以更少参数超过基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是通用的 LoRA 改进与优化器友好性工作，关注参数化秩与微调效率，未涉及视觉细节保留、latent 推理状态生成、证据筛选或停止决策，仅在推理基准上报告精度提升，缺少可供核查的 LVR 具体线索。
